cards.card_text: Here's where Paul keeps talking: those natural branches were broken off because of unbelief.
cards.verse_text: That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith.
cards.snippet: That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith.

cards.card_text: The natural branches were broken off because of unbelief, but Paul says the grafted-in shoot stands by ___.
cards.verse_text: That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith.
cards.snippet: That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith.

cards.card_text: Paul says that if the broken-off branches do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in.
cards.verse_text: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
cards.snippet: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them…

cards.card_text: Paul says that back when he was a persecutor, he acted in ignorance and unbelief.
cards.verse_text: I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.
cards.snippet: …and a violent man; yet because I had acted in ignorance and unbelief, I was shown mercy.

cards.verse_text: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.
cards.snippet: …to it, brothers, that none of you has a wicked heart of unbelief that turns away from the living God.

cards.card_text: Their bodies fell in the wilderness, and the writer sums it all up: “So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.” That's the same unbelief he warned the brothers about.
cards.verse_text: So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.
